title: Example killed topic
claim: Recalibrating per-detection confidence scores with one monotone function (for example a sigmoid temperature on the logit) changes AP rankings.

killers.title: Theory-forced (runner derivation): AP depends only on the ranking of scores
killers.why: one monotone transform applied to every score preserves the ranking, so AP cannot change

title: Example near-miss
claim: Label smoothing during fine-tuning improves calibration under distribution shift more than post-hoc temperature scaling at equal compute.
near_miss_b0: Promote if expected calibration error on a shifted split improves by at least 1 point over temperature scaling, with a paired CI excluding 0.
